Iran’s IRGC Navy says it captured a second U.S. underwater drone in the Strait of Hormuz.

The IRGC said the REMUS 600 was conducting surveillance when it was seized in a coordinated electronic-warfare operation. It said specialists are now extracting data from the drone. https:/
